bio: Set on the outskirts of the village of Beaulieu in the middle of vast open heathlands of the New Forest is our former coaching Inn, Beaulieu Inn.  Experience the quiet beauty of the New Forest and it’s wandering wildlife whilst relaxing in our Taylor’s bar and lounge on a sumptuous Afternoon Tea.  Taylor’s bar and lounge is dotted with plush, cosy seating areas and relaxed, informal spaces with stunning views over the surrounding heath land. By day, the lounge is home to Afternoon Tea and the perfect spot for catching up with friends – enjoying copious amounts of cake and freshly baked scones.  Not forgetting the little ones we have specially designed afternoon tea with all the favourites and a little fun activity to keep them entertained.
